WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tr.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tx.transreg)::numeric AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx
    ON ab.translink = tx.transreg
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM type_counts
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  transaction_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM compared
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
  AND share > average_share;
